title: Helsinborg earn Superettan title
description: Helsingborg - Eskilstuna 87-74 Helsinborg conquered Superettan title. They overcame Eskilstuna in the decisive third game of the championship series to capture the trophy. The game was mostly controlled by Helsingborg. Eskilstuna managed to win second period 18-17. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. It was a great evening for forward Samoro Unger (195-1994) who led his team to a victory with a double-double by scoring 25 points and 10 rebounds (on 11-of-13 shooting from the field). Guard Alexander Smakowski (188-2000) helped adding 22 points and 4 assists. The best for the losing side was forward Adam Karahmetovic (189-1998) with 16 points, 8 rebounds and 4 assists and guard Einar Bradd (187-2000) scored 8 points, 8 rebounds and 4 assists. Both teams had four players each who scored in double figures.
